MN202611_1bfyfnzqmel.t: Africa needs to invest more in its writers and publishing industry if it is to produce its own knowledge and find solutions to its problems, Amb. Williams Nkurunziza has said. Speaking at the Africa Writers Day celebration in Kigali on Saturday, November 7, the veteran diplomat and writer said the continent was spending heavily on books produced elsewhere while publishing fewer of its own. ALSO READ: Rwanda to host Africa Writers Day celebration He said Africa published about 86,000 books in 2024, compared with between 400,000 and 470,000 in China. The United States published about 400,000, while the United Kingdom produced approximately 190,000. No African country featured among the world’s 10 largest book-producing countries, he said. On the continent, Egypt leads book production with about 27,000 titles annually, followed by Nigeria with 15,000 and South Africa with 10,000. Kenya is the leading publisher in East Africa, producing about 5,000 titles a year. Nkurunziza said the figures show the need of writing and publishing in the development of societies. He noted that the world’s leading economies were also among the biggest producers of books. “We cannot outsource our understanding to outsiders. Africa spends about $600 million annually importing books, yet that money could be invested in our own writers and publishers,” Nkurunziza said. He traced the role of writing in the development of societies, noting that before the printing press emerged in the 15th century, knowledge was passed down through oral traditions and handwritten manuscripts. The invention of the printing press made it easier to share ideas across borders and reach wider audiences. Nkurunziza discussed the influence of African writers such as Ngũgĩ wa Thiong’o, Wole Soyinka and Chinua Achebe, whose works inspired anti-colonial movements. He referred to the scholarship that flourished in Timbuktu during the reign of Mansa Musa in Mali, illustrating the importance of writing and passing on knowledge in the development of societies. Making writing a viable career Olawale Okediran, Secretary General of the Pan-African Writers’ Association (PAWA), said African writers also needed better opportunities to earn a living from their work. He said many young African writers are uncertain whether they could earn a living from writing, with questions about potential income often discouraging them from pursuing it as a career. Okediran said African stories are increasingly being adapted into films, creating opportunities for writers to earn from their works. He said PAWA is organising a project to share films written and produced in African countries across the continent. He called for more support for writing in indigenous languages, saying African literature should not be limited to languages inherited from colonial rule. “Authors lose income when their books are photocopied without payment. PAWA is therefore advocating for the recognition of reproductive rights, which would allow authors to earn from the reproduction of their works, including photocopying in educational institutions,” Okediran said. He stated that African governments should support writers and the publishing industry, saying writing could become a viable commercial venture if authors were given the right opportunities. Richard Hategekimana, Chairman of the Rwanda Books Industry Association, noted that publishing should be treated as an economic activity that creates jobs, supports education and contributes to the creative economy. “The African book industry must move from being viewed primarily as an educational activity to being organised as a strategic economic sector,” he said. Hategekimana highlighted the need for African publishers to collaborate across national markets, making it easier for books, knowledge and ideas to cross borders and reach readers across the continent.

New Zealand election 'too close to call' - so who's won?

There was no clear winner following New Zealand's election on Saturday, as the leaders of its two major parties preparing for negotiations to form a coalition government.

Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's centre-right National Party won 42 seats but was 19 short of the simple majority needed to form a government, despite being the largest party, preliminary results show.

Combined with their coalition partners ACT and New Zealand First, they would have a slim lead over the left-leaning bloc if a deal could be reached.

But opposition leader Chris Hipkins, whose Labour Party won 36 seats, showed no signs of conceding, saying the "shape of the next government" will remain uncertain "for a while".

The tight result followed a campaign shaped by the cost of living and unemployment.

Projections show the National Party on 42 seats and Labour on 36. The Greens are on 16, with ACT on 13, New Zealand First on 12, the Opportunity Party on 7 and Te Pāti Māori, which represents Māori interests, on 5.

New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon addressed supporters in Auckland as votes were being counted

The electoral commission was not due to announce the official result until 27 November.

Luxon congratulated Hipkins on a "very hard-fought race" before addressing party colleagues, saying "whatever the final count, we are incredibly proud of each and everyone for you".

He said he would run a caretaker government until the final results were confirmed later in the month, adding: "With those final results there can then be meaningful negotiations."

Elsewhere, Labour leader Hipkins said "the people have spoken", adding: "It may take a bit longer to work out what they've said."

Hipkins said the results made clear the "next parliament is going to require all of us to compromise, to work together and to find a common ground".

More than 99% of votes have been counted in New Zealand, with National and Labour neck-and-neck in terms of vote share.

But the preliminary results pointed to historically low support for the two major parties, with a combined vote share of around 60%.

They were followed by the Greens, ACT, New Zealand First, centrist party Opportunity and Te Pāti Māori, which represents Māori interests.

New Zealand election 2026: What you need to know

The Opportunity Party crossed the 5% threshold to enter parliament for the first time, with leader Qiulae Wong saying would work with either side.

It has been described as this election's kingmaker as it remains open to working with either major bloc, but its leaders said they would negotiate first with the party that secures the most seats.

Speaking at Opportunity's watch party, Wong told supporters: "We believe that we can change the way we do politics to focus on the future, on the next generation, and on finding common ground."

Professor Andrew Geddis from the University of Otago, an expert in election law, said "the Opportunity Party as a wildcard player" could "determine which bloc of parties is able to govern".

"It will come down to some very fine vote margins not just between the parties, but in individual electorates. We are going to have to wait for the special votes to be processed and counted over the next three weeks," he said.

Special votes are votes cast outside a voter's electorate, including overseas.

The Greens – who have proposed forcing the country's two main supermarkets to divest stores to create publicly-owned shops – saw their vote rise by a couple of percentage points.

Labour Party leader Chris Hipkins speaking to supporters

Julian McCrann, head of polling at Roy Morgan, told BBC News the cost of living was the main issue for many New Zealanders

"Three years ago, Luxon came in saying he'd be making New Zealanders' lives better and solving these economic issues, but he hasn't really delivered," he said.

More than half of the country no longer see New Zealand as a land of opportunity, according to an annual social cohesion survey. Record numbers of Kiwis have been leaving the country, with many going to Australia.

New Zealand's mixed-member proportional voting system means most governments are coalitions.

Each voter makes two choices – for the representative of their constituency in parliament and a political party.

Michel Barnier says there will be 'no cherry-picking' in a deal for the UK to returns to the EU

The EU's former Brexit negotiator has warned that the UK cannot "cherry pick" which elements of the single market to which it subscribes, after Andy Burnham said he wanted to explore closer economic ties with Europe.

The prime minister has said rejoining the bloc's internal market was among options he could pursue as part of a reshaping of ties since the UK's exit from the EU nearly six years ago.

But Michel Barnier told the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg that EU members would insist on the UK readopting certain conditions, such as the free movement of people, to gain access.

He said there was not a "single market à la carte" menu from which the UK could pick and choose what elements it wanted to adopt.

Barnier - who led the EU delegation during Brexit talks between 2016 and 2021, and had a three-month spell as French prime minister in 2024 - said the "door is open" within Europe to the UK rejoining as an EU member.

But he insisted that any move to rejoin the single market - which allows for goods to be freely traded without border controls - would require the UK to follow the same terms as other members.

He added that this included compliance with regulations designed to promote the circulation of goods, services, capital and people, referred to collectively within EU institutions as the "four freedoms".

"There will be no possibility to have one freedom and not the other. The four freedoms are clearly the four conditions to be inside a single market."

Since becoming prime minister in July, Burnham has suggested he could commit Labour to pursuing a much closer future relationship with Europe, including asking to rejoin the organisation as a full member, though he has ruled out major changes before the next election.

His predecessors have struck a series of deals with the EU on different aspects of how the UK and EU interact post-Brexit.

Both sides are hoping to use a meeting in Brussels in 10 days' time to unveil deals on food standards, youth visas and re-linking British industry to the EU's carbon trading regime .

Why the prime minister wants to talk about Brexit again

Of the four freedoms, the free movement of people - which allows EU citizens to live and work elsewhere in the bloc without a visa - was a key issue during the 2016 Brexit referendum.

Burnham's immediate predecessor, Sir Keir Starmer, ruled out re-establishing it for the UK in Labour's 2024 election manifesto and any move to advocate it again would prove a key dividing line with the Conservatives and Reform UK at a future poll.

Burnham recently said in an interview that he would not re-establish free movement of people without a referendum, prompting Downing Street to clarify that he was not advocating its return at this point.

He has previously said he wanted to lay out "different options" for the relationship with Europe at the Brussels summit later this month, before trying to find a consensus with the British public on a new relationship.

Barnier also predicted that EU countries would reject reinstating the British financial rebate, first negotiated in 1985, that lowered UK contributions towards the EU's annual budget while it was a member.

The UK's decision to leave the bloc had created "a new situation", he said, meaning a new rebate would be "off the table".

Barnier also compared Reform leader Nigel Farage to French politician Marine Le Pen. He said: "We have our own Farage. It is Mrs Le Pen. The same populism, the same lies, the same false promises."

Asked by Kuenssberg to clarify what he was referring to with his accusation of lies, Barnier said "for instance, when Mr Farage and Mr Johnson promised the UK people to get back [£350] million per week, it was not true, it was not possible. It was a lie".

The Vote Leave campaign, of which Boris Johnson became a key figure, has been criticised previously for the slogan on the side of their campaign bus that said Britain sent £350m a week to the EU, adding: "Let's fund our NHS instead".

Johnson said in 2017 that "once we have settled our accounts, we will take back control of roughly £350m per week. It would be a fine thing as many of us have pointed out if a lot of that money went on the NHS".

Critics have said that the £350m per week was an approximate sum which represents a "gross contribution" and did not take into account the UK's £75m-a-week rebate nor the EU's investments in the UK.

Johnson has since defended the claim, saying the £350m was based on the UK's gross contribution to the EU, and was in fact an underestimate as UK contributions were due to rise.

​In his memoirs published in 2024, Johnson said EU money spent in the UK was not "democratically controlled by the British people", and "even if the net figure was only £175m, that was still a hell of a lot of money".

Farage, who led Leave UK and was not part of the Vote Leave campaign so not connected to the £350m claim, said: "It is the same old Barnier - arrogant, out of touch and a bully. He vindicates our decision to leave every time he opens his mouth."

Ubwo ku nshuro ya 13 mu Rwanda hatangwaga ibihembo ku banyamakuru babaye indashyikirwa bitangwa hagamijwe kuzirikana uruhare rwabo mu guteza imbere ibikorwa bitandukanye, banashimirwa umuhate muri uyu mwuga, umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today Marie Jeanne Umutoni yatunguwe no guhamagarwa nk’indashykirwa akigera ahatangirwaga ibihembo.

Ni ibihembo byatanzwe ku mugoroba wo ku wa 6 Ugushyingo 2026, mu muhango wabereye muri Camp Kigali, wahuje abanyamakuru, abayobozi ba Leta, ibigo by’itangazamakuru n’abafatanyabikorwa mu iterambere, mu rwego rwo kwizihiza Umunsi Nyafurika wahariwe amakuru (Africa Day of Information) no gutanga ibihembo ngarukamwaka by’itangazamakuru.

Inkuru zahembwe ni 30 zo mu byiciro byihariye byatoranyijwe, zirimo iy'umunyamakuru wa Kigali Today Marie Jeanne Umuntoni yakoze kuri KT Radio, igaragaza ihohotera rikorerwa abagore n’abana.

Marie Jeanne Umutoni wari wiriwe mu kazi kuri KT Radio, avuga ko yatunguwe kuko atari abyiteze nubwo yari yaratanze inkuru ihatana.

Ati “Byarantunguye kuko nari nakoze ndi mu makuru ya nimugoroba nk’ibisanzwe, yarangiye saa moya, ndavuga nti reka ngende aho abandi bari nishimane n’abandi, nk’umuntu wari urangije akazi saa moya numvaga ko ngerayo byarangiye. Nkihagera ntangiye kwiyandika, numva baravuze ngo uwatsindiye muri iki cyiciro ni Marie Jeanne wa KT Radio na Kigali Today, ntararangiza no kwiyandika mpita nsimbuka ngenda niruka ngiye kwakira igihembo. Ni ibintu byantunguye kuko naje numva ko banarangije gutanga ibihembo.”

Nubwo atari ubwa mbere yari atsindiye igihembo kandi muri icyo cyiro, ariko ngo ku nshuro ya mbere hari mu 2024 ubwo yakoreraga radio Salus, ari bwo bwa mbere yitabiriye ayo marushanwa, ariko ho yari yandikiwe ubutumwa bumumenyesha ko agomba kwitabira ibirori by’itangwa ry’ibihembo ndetse anahamagarwa kuri telefone.

Ati “Ejo rero numvaga abandi bavuga ngo babahaye ubutumwa, nta na kimwe jye nari nabonye, niyo mpamvu byantunguye, ndavuga nti bishoboka bite ko nta kintu na kimwe bampaye, habe n’amakuru nari mfite, usibye kuba nari nzi ko umunsi nyirizina wageze, isaha nyizi nkuko babitambutsaga ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zitandukanye.”

Inkuru yahembewe ivuga ku bagore babyara abana bafite ubumuga bw’uruhu, yubakiye ku mubyeyi wabyaye abana babiri bafite ubwo bumuga, agatangira kujya atotezwa n’umugabo kugera aho byabaviriyemo gutandukana.

Ni inkuru ashimira ubuyobozi bwa Kigali Today by’umwihariko umutokozi wa KT Radio (Editor), avuga ko nubwo yagize igitekerezo cyo kuyikora, ariko bamufashije kuyiha umurongo bigatuma igera ku ntego yari yayiteguriye.

Kuba amaze guhembwa kabiri mu myaka itatu ikurikirana, avuga ko ari ikintu kimwongerera imbaraga mu mwuga we w’itangazamakuru.

Ati “Bintera imbaraga zo kuba narushaho gukunda itangazamakuru kuko ni umuhamagaro wanjye, ni ibintu nize mbikunze, mbikora mbikunze, hanyuma kuba umuntu yahembwa rimwe, akongera ubwa kabiri, bihita bimwereka ko ibyo byose ibintu akora hari aho bigera kure, kandi bakabona hari imbaraga aba yashyizemo zirenze.”

Ibi kandi ngo binamuha imbaraga zo gutekereza no gukora cyane, kugira ngo akomeze gufasha no kuvugira ba bandi badafite kivugira, kuko iyo ukoze ntuhembwe cyangwa ntihagire ukwereka ko hari icyo wakoze, hari igihe utekereza ko ibyo ukora nta cyo bimaze cyangwa bigarukira aho.

Uyu mukobwa urimo kwiga icyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza mu itangazamakuru, avuga ko afite inzozi ngari muri uyu uwo mwuga kandi ko na Kigali Today ari igitangazamakuru kigari kuko gikurikirwa na benshi, ku buryo asanga ari inzira nziza izakomeza kumwagurira amarembo ku buryo adashidikanya ko hashobora kumubera ikiraro kimufasha kuzikabya.

Ibihembo by’abanyamakuru babaye indashykirwa (Development Journalism Awards) bitangwa n’Ishyirahamwe ry’Abanyamakuru mu Rwanda (ARJ) ku bufatanye n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Imiyoborere mu Rwanda (RGB), byatanzwe bwa mbere mu 2012. Icyo gihe abanyamakuru icyenda nibo bahembwe mu byiciro bitandukanye birimo inkuru z’iperereza, ubucuruzi, siporo, ibidukikije n’ibindi.

MN202611_kd6mg1vegv.t:
Perezida w’Ishyaka Riharanira Demokarasi no Kurengera Ibidukikije mu Rwanda (DGPR), Senateri Dr Frank Habineza, yasabye abarwanashyaka baryo gukomeza kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubudaheranwa, birinda amacakubiri kandi bagaharanira gukemura ibibazo bahura na byo mu nzira z’amahoro.

Yabigarutseho ubwo yitabiraga inama n’amahugurwa by’abarwanashyaka ba DGPR mu Karere ka Rwamagana, aho yasabye abayoboke b’iri shyaka n’abaturage muri rusange kugira uruhare mu kubaka umuryango Nyarwanda urangwa n’amahoro, ubwubahane n’ubufatanye.

Dr Habineza yavuze ko ubumwe n’ubwiyunge biri mu mahame shingiro y’ishyaka DGPR, asaba abayoboke baryo kuyashyira mu bikorwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi, bakirinda imyumvire n’ibikorwa bishobora gusubiza igihugu mu bihe bibi cyanyuzemo.

Yagaragaje ko nubwo u Rwanda rumaze gutera intambwe mu kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, hakiri ngombwa gukomeza ubukangurambaga bwo kurwanya amacakubiri no gukomeza kubaka umubano mwiza hagati y’Abanyarwanda.

Ati: “Ni umwanya mwiza wo kwishimira intambwe imaze guterwa mu kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubudaheranwa, kuganira ku nzitizi zikiriho no gufata ingamba zo kubumbatira Ubunyarwanda nk’isano ihuza Abanyarwanda.”

Yasabye abarwanashyaka ba Green Party kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubudaheranwa nk’indangagaciro bakomora ku bakurambere b’u Rwanda, bakazigira umurage basigira abazabakomokaho.

Ati: “Umurwanashyaka wa Green Party agomba gufata iya mbere mu guhangana n’abashobora guhungabanya ubumwe n’ubwiyunge bw’Abanyarwanda, cyane cyane abakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga.”

Dr Habineza kandi yagarutse ku ruhare rw’urubyiruko mu gusigasira ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda, agaragaza ko ari rwo rugize umubare munini w’abaturage b’igihugu, bityo rukaba rukwiye kugira uruhare rukomeye mu kubaka u Rwanda rutagira amacakubiri.

Yarusabye kwamagana uwo ari we wese washaka kugarura amacakubiri mu Banyarwanda, ahubwo rugaharanira igihugu kirangwa n’amahoro n’iterambere.

Nyiramugeni Nadia avuga ko nk’urubyiruko batifuza abababibamo imvugo zicamo Abanyarwanda ibice, kuko nta cyiza kiri mu macakubiri, ari na yo mpamvu biyemeje kurwanya abayakwirakwiza n’abayashishikariza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.

Ati: “Icya mbere ni ugushishikariza urubyiruko gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga mu bikorwa by’iterambere, birinda kuzikoresha mu gusebya igihugu, ahubwo zikifashishwa mu kugaragaza ibyiza byacyo.”

Maniriho Mariko yavuze ko urubyiruko rudakwiriye kwemera kuyobywa n’abagoreka amateka y’igihugu bagamije gusenya ubumwe n’ubudaheranwa byAbanyarwanda.

Ati: “Tujye tubanyomoza tugaragaza ko ibyo bavuga atari ukuri, ahubwo dutange ishusho nyayo y’uko igihugu gihagaze.”

Mu gusoza, Dr Frank Habineza yasabye abarwanashyaka ba DGPR gukomeza kuba intangarugero mu kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubudaheranwa, barwanya imvugo n’ibikorwa by’amacakubiri, by’umwihariko ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.

Yashimangiye ko kubaka u Rwanda rurangwa n’amahoro, ubwubahane n’ubufatanye bisaba uruhare rwa buri wese, cyane cyane urubyiruko, mu gusigasira ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda no kubusigira abazabakomokaho.

MN202611_1jfhndq6fek.t:
Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika na Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo byiyemeje kwihutisha no gushimangira ubufatanye mu bijyanye n’umutekano n’ishoramari, by’umwihariko mu bucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro.

Ibi byatangajwe na Amerika mu itangazo yasohoye nyuma y’inama yahuje abahagarariye ibyo bihugu ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 6 Ugushyingo 2026, i Paris mu Bufaransa, baganira ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano y’ubufatanye asanzwe hagati yabyo.

Uretse ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro, Amerika yagaragaje ko ishaka no kongera ishoramari muri RDC mu nzego zirimo ingufu n’ubwikorezi bw’abantu n’ibintu.

Aya masezerano yashyizweho umukono hagati y’ibihugu byombi mu mpera za 2025, mu gihe Perezida Félix Tshisekedi yashakaga ko Amerika igira uruhare rukomeye mu gukemura ikibazo cy’umutekano muke kimaze igihe mu burasirazuba bwa RDC.

Mu burasirazuba bw’iki gihugu hakomeje imirwano ihanganishije ingabo za Leta n’umutwe wa AFC/M23, uherutse guhindura izina ukitwa FRN, umaze kwigarurira ibice bitandukanye byo mu Ntara za Kivu y’Amajyaruguru n’iy’Amajyepfo.

Guverinoma ya RDC n’impuguke z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye bashinja u Rwanda gufasha uwo mutwe, ibirego u Rwanda ruhakana. Ruvuga ko ingamba rwafashe zigamije kurinda umutekano warwo.

Nubwo Amerika yatangaje ko ishaka kwihutisha ubufatanye n’ishoramari muri RDC, itangazo ryayo ntiryagaragaje amafaranga imaze gushora muri icyo gihugu, ingano y’ayo iteganya gushora mu gihe kiri imbere cyangwa igihe imishinga itandukanye izatangirira.

Ntiryanasobanuye kandi uturere ibikorwa byo gucukura amabuye y’agaciro bizibandaho.

Amasezerano yashyizweho umukono tariki ya 4 Ukuboza 2025, yemerera abashoramari b’Abanyamerika kugenzura ibirombe byinshi by’amabuye y’agaciro muri RDC kugira ngo Amerika na yo izafashe iki gihugu kubaka inzego z’umutekano zacyo.

Ni amabuye y’agaciro akenewe cyane ku isoko mpuzamahanga, arimo cobalt, umuringa, lithium na germanium, akoreshwa mu nganda zitandukanye zirimo iz’ikoranabuhanga n’ingufu.

Nk’uko bigaragara muri iryo tangazo, impande zombi zemeje ko amahoro n’umutekano ari byo bizatuma ayo masezerano agera ku ntego yayo yo guteza imbere RDC n’abaturage bayo mu buryo burambye.

Perezida Donald Trump yigeze gutangaza ko yahagaritse intambara yo muri RDC, bityo ko yiteguye kujya gucukura amabuye Tshisekedi yamwijeje, hagati muri Mutarama 2026 Leta ya RDC yohereje i Washington D.C urutonde rw’ibirombe abashoramari b’Abanyamerika bazagenzura.

The New York Knicks has defended superstar Taylor Swift, after players named her as the fakest celebrity fan.

The basketball team's point guards Tyler Kolek and Miles McBride were asked who the least genuine celebrity Knicks fan was during a NBA 2K livestream on Thursday.

"At the Knicks games, I would say it's very performative, cause like they just want to be seen at the game, they're not necessarily fans. Maybe Taylor Swift?" Kolek responded.

In May and June this year, Swift attended Game Three of the NBA Eastern Conference Finals in Cleveland and Game Four of the NBA Finals in New York City .

"I don't know if I've seen her at any other games," Kolak said.

Swift was part of a star-studded crowd that saw the Knicks comeback from behind to win Game Four in June

A spokesperson for the Knicks defended Swift on Friday, telling media: "Taylor Swift has been a Knicks fan for many years, has a long history with Madison Square Garden, and we are incredibly appreciative of her support of the organisation."

The BBC has approached the Knicks for comment.

McBride added that "everybody else is usually solid", citing actor Ben Stiller and comedian Tracy Morgan as examples.

Tyler Kolek said Taylor Swift at Knicks games was "a little performative"

Kolek joked he was "gonna get some hate from the Swifties" and noted "she's got a lot going on so she can't come all the time... it's a little performative".

During Game Four of the NBA Finals, Swift watched alongside musicians Este Haim, Alana Haim and actor Mariska Hargitay in matching blue shirts with either "Stevie Knicks", "Knickelback" or "Knickole Kidman" written in orange.

The Knicks later went on to win their first championship in over 50 years, beating the San Antonio Spurs 94-90 in Game Five - sending New York City into a frenzy.

Miles McBride said actors Ben Stiller and Tracy Morgan were "usually solid" fans

Swift has attended other games in the past, including a game between the Chicago Bulls and the Knicks in October 2014 and a match up against Orlando Magic in November 2014.

The pop-star's connection with Madison Square Garden runs deep as she has performed there for two of her tours , external "Fearless" in 2009 and "Speak Now" in 2011.

In July this year, Swift and her husband Travis Kelce got married at Madison Square Garden , in a star-studded ceremony officiated by actor Adam Sandler.

Few details about the wedding have been released, with Swift's publicist confirming at the time both the singer and Kelce wore Christian Dior. Neither had bridesmaids or groomsmen.

Swift's brother, Austin Swift, served as her man of honour, and Jason Kelce, Travis's brother, was his best man.

Rebels of the Front for Refoundation of the Nation (FRN) have unsuccessfully attempted to recapture Mahanga, in Butsike area (Nyamaboko 1 group) in Masisi, North Kivu.

The rebels had been dislodged from Mahanga three days ago by the Congolese troops FARDC.

According to security sources, FRN rebels launched an attack to recapture the village from which they had been driven out last Wednesday by government forces and their allies.

After several hours of fighting, marked by heavy and light weapons fire, the FARDC and the Wazalendo rebels managed to contain the offensive before repelling the rebels.

The FRN rebels have retreated to Kasopo, their initial position.

Meanwhile, loyalist forces are consolidating their presence in the area to prevent any further attempts at reconquest.

The attempt by rebels to recapture Mahanga flared off after reinforcements came in from Nyabiondo to FRN including extra rebels and ammunition.

Eyewitnesses on ground told Taarifa that the situation had return to normal on Saturday morning.

However, in Mahanga, the Congolese military presence remains reinforced in a still fragile security context.

Employees inspect the damage of a kindergarten in Kyiv following a Russian missile attack

Overnight drone and ballistic missile attacks damaged Ukrainian energy infrastructure, President Volodymyr Zelenskyhas said, causing blackouts and disrupting water supplies.

Zelensky said 12 Ukrainian regions came under attack with the capital Kyiv hit hardest.

Nine people are reported to have been hurt across the country, including one child, in the wave of attacks that consisted of more than 30 ballistic missiles and over 170 drones.

The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

Zelensky wrote on Telegram , external that Moscow was preparing for the talks by launching attacks on Ukraine's "critical infrastructure".

Temperatures are dropping in Ukraine, and parts of the country have had the first winter snow.

"The situation in the capital is difficult, with disruptions to electricity, water, and heating supplies. Residential buildings, the North Bridge, and a kindergarten have been damaged," Zelensky said.

"In the Kyiv region, there were strikes on substations that connect the Rivne and Khmelnytsky nuclear power plants to Kyiv and central Ukraine."

In his latest update, Kyiv's Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the city's water supply system is back to operating normally. He also said around 60% of the city's apartment buildings were connected to the heating system.

The energy minister, Denys Shmyhal, said there were power cuts in five regions but did not say how many homes were affected.

Debris and a broken window inside the kindergarten in Kyiv

Zelensky added that beyond Kyiv, substations were damaged in Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv and Dnipro regions.

The latest attacks come after US First Lady Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian delegations at the White House on Thursday.

She called for a "more enduring" ceasefire in Ukraine following a truce last week in the southern region of Kherson.

She thanked both Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin, making no reference to the origins of the war, which began when Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, which has caused thousands of civilian casualties and the displacement of millions.

Hundreds of residents of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky facing starvation and constant bombardment were able to evacuate during a six-day ceasefire , which both Moscow and Kyiv credited Trump with brokering.

"The lives of innocent people must transcend the division of war. I hope Oleshky inspires greater peace," she said.

Earlier this week, a number of people were killed when glide bombs hit an aid centre near Zaporizhzhia , with the death toll rising to 55 as teams search deeper into the ruins.

Zelensky added in his Telegram post on Saturday following the latest attacks that Ukraine was counting on increased bilateral support from the United States.

He wrote: "We are counting on unity between both parties on issues of security, support for Ukraine, condemnation of Russian aggression, and increased sanctions pressure on Putin.

"The resolve and consistency of the United States in supporting Ukraine are of great importance in bringing peace closer."

Meanwhile, Zelenksy's spokesperson would not be drawn on reports that the Ukrainian president is to be invited to the UK for a state visit next year.

Additional reporting by Daniel Wittenberg

Ahavuye isanamu, Bloomberg via Getty Images

Perezida wa Paraguay, Santiago Peña, yakuwe ku butegetsi yongera apfungirwa muhira iwe ic'amaso, inyuma y'uko ihomba rya banki ritumye haba ingorane zikomeye, abarenga ica kabiri c'abanyagihugu bakabura ingene bashikira amafaranga ari kuri konte zabo.

Peña yatawe muri yompi ku wa gatanu, haciye iminota mike abashingamateka, harimwo n'abo mu mugambwe wiwe, bemeje bose hamwe ko akurwa ku butegetsi. Ivyo vyakurikiye ihomba rya banki Ueno Bank ryabaye mu ntango z'iyi ndwi. Iyo banki ifitaniye isano n'ibikorwa vy'ubudandaji bwite vya Peña.

Ku wa kane, yari yemeye gutanga imihoho. Ariko aho kwemera iyo mihoho, abakenguzamateka bahisemwo kumukura ku butegetsi biciye mu nzira yo kumwagiriza amakosa yakoze mu gihe c'amabanga yiwe. Vyatumye atakaza ubudahangarwa mu vy'amategeko busanzwe buhabwa abahoze ari abakuru b'ibihugu.

Peña, gushika mu mwaka uheze yari agifise imitahe mw'ishirahamwe ryagenzura iyo banki, yahakanye ko hari ikibi yakoze.

Ibirego vyatumye Peña akurwa ku butegetsi vyavuga ko yagiye afata ingingo zishira imbere inyungu ziwe bwite zidahuye n'amabanga yari ajejwe, ko yakoresheje nabi uburyo bwo kugenzura ivy'igihugu, anyonora amahera y'ikigo c'imigambi y'abageze mu zabukuru, hamwe n'uko yagize uruhara mu guhishira amakosa yabaye ku rwego rw'inzego za reta, harimwo n'ibanki nkuru y'igihugu.

Umushikirizamanza Silvia Margarita Gonzalez Vester yavuze ko bitegekanijwe ko Peña abazwa, ku wa gatandatu, ku birego vyo guhemuka mu gihe c'amabanga yiwe, ivyo gukoresha nabi ububasha yari afise kugira aronke inyungu, hamwe no kunyuruza amahera.

Icegera ca Peña, Pedro Alliana, yararahiriye kuba umukuru w'igihugu w'imfatakibanza, aca asezerana ko atazoheba abantu amamiliyoni bagizweko ingaruka n'ico cago.

Yavuze ati: "Abenegihugu dusangiye igihugu bariko baraca mu bihe bitoroshe kubera ihomba ry'amabanki, bazoronka indishi yuzuye."

Amakuru ya BBC Gahuza ako kanya kuri WhatsApp yawe

Azoguma ari umukuru w'igihugu gushika mu 2028.

Ihomba ry'iyo banki yakoresha ubuhinga bwa none ryatumye abarenga ica kabiri c'abanyagihugu ba Paraguay badashobora gushikira amahera yabo bari baraziganije, inyuma y'uko Ibanki nkuru ya Paraguay iyigaruriye.

Ku wa kabiri no ku wa gatatu, abantu benshi bari ku mirongo miremire imbere y'amashami y'ibanki Ueno, barondera kubikura amahera yabo. Iyo mirongo yarashika no mu mabarabara yo mu gisagara ca Asunción, umurwa mukuru w'ico gihugu.

Bivugwa ko abantu bashika imiliyoni zitatu bari baraziganije amahera muri iyo banki batari bagishobora kuyaronka, harimwo n'amahera y'ikiruhuko c'izabukuru c'abakozi. Ivyo vyatumye abantu benshi bashavura, cane cane ku murwa mukuru Asunción.

Mu kugaragaza ishavu, abantu ibihumbi n'ibihumbi bihereje amabarabara ku wa kane, basaba ko basubizwa amahera yabo.

Mu myiyerekano yari yabaye imbere y'aho, haradutse ugutana mu mitwe hagati y'abanyagihugu n'igipolisi. Ico gipolisi cakoresheje ivyuka bikoroza amosozi n'ibimodoka bitera amazi kugira bibashwiragize.

Igikorwa co gukura Peña ku butegetsi cemejwe n'abakenguzamateka 44 kuri 45 bagize inama nkenguzamateka. Umwe muri bo ntiyari yitavye.

Mu butumwa yashize ku rubuga X amenyesha ko atanze imihoho, Peña yavuze ati: "Sinigeze ngira umugambi wo guhemukira icizere mwari mwampaye." Yongeyeko ko ikintu yashira imbere ari "ukuronsa amahoro yo mu mutima abanyagihugu ba Paraguay batubikije amahera ...."

Inyuma y'ivyo, umukuru w'inama nkenguzamateka, Basilio Núñez, yavuze ko Peña yagiriwe n'amakosa yo kutarangura neza amabanga yari ajejwe.

Abantu bafite ubumuga mu Rwanda barashimira umushinga wa ‘Turengere Abafite Ubumuga’ wabafashije kwihangira imirimo, kwizigamira no kwitabira ibikorwa by’iterambere, bityo ukabafasha kwikura mu bukene n’ubwigunge.

Ibi babigarutseho ku wa 6 Ugushyingo 2026, ubwo hasozwaga umushinga watangiye mu 2023, ugamije guteza imbere imibereho y’abantu bafite ubumuga, kubongerera ubushobozi no kubafasha kugira uruhare mu bikorwa by’iterambere.

Abagenerwabikorwa bagaragaje ko mbere y’umushinga bahuraga n’ibibazo birimo kubura ubushobozi bwo kwiteza imbere, kubona ibikorwa bibinjiriza amafaranga no kwigunga, ariko ko kwishyira hamwe no gushyigikirwa byabafashije kunoza imibereho yabo.

Umwe muri bo yagize ati: “Mbere nari umuntu waheranywe n’agahinda kubera ubumuga, nkaba aho ntazwi, ariko ubu twagiye ahabona, tujya mu matsinda. Ubu mbasha gufata ku mafaranga ntasabirije.”

Undi na we yavuze ko umushinga wamufashije gusobanukirwa ko kugira ubumuga bitamubuza gukora no kwiteza imbere.

Ati: “Aya mafaranga nubwo ari make amaze kutugeza ku bintu bifatika. Byumvikana ko aramutse yiyongereye byadufasha kugera kuri byinshi biruseho.”

Umwe mu musaruro w’uyu mushinga ni ugushyiraho no gushyigikira amatsinda y’ababyeyi bafite abana bafite ubumuga, agamije kubafasha kwishyira hamwe, gukora ibikorwa bibyara inyungu no kongera ubushobozi bwo kwita ku miryango yabo.

Dr. Nicodème Hakizimana, Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Umuryango Nyarwanda w’Abantu bafite Ubumuga bw’Uruhu (OIPPA), yavuze ko ababyeyi 139, barimo abagore 111 n’abagabo 28, bashyizwe mu matsinda ane akora ibikorwa bibyara inyungu.

Yagize ati: “Kimwe mu byagezweho by’ingenzi ni ugushyiraho no gushyigikira amatsinda y’ababyeyi bafite abana bafite ubumuga, hagamijwe guteza imbere no kongerera ubushobozi bwo kwita ku miryango yabo.”

Urugero ni itsinda rya Tubakunde rikorera mu Murenge wa Cyeza mu Karere ka Muhanga, rimaze kugira abanyamuryango 43. Rikora ubworozi bw’ingurube, aho abanyamuryango banifatanya mu bikorwa byo kwizigamira no gufashanya.

Uyu mushinga kandi wibanze ku kongerera ubushobozi imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bw’abantu bafite ubumuga, gukangurira inzego z’ibanze kubashyira muri gahunda z’iterambere no gufasha urubyiruko rufite ubumuga kwitabira ibikorwa bibyara inyungu.

Watewe inkunga n’Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi (EU), ushyirwa mu bikorwa ku bufatanye n’imiryango ya AIMPO, OIPPA, HIHD na ISDO.

Uwari uhagarariye Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, Dr. Vanessa Mupenzi, yashimye imiryango yagize uruhare mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uyu mushinga, avuga ko buri Munyarwanda afite uburenganzira bwo kugira ubuzima bwiza no kubona serivisi z’ubuzima, yaba afite ubumuga cyangwa atabufite.

Yavuze ko hari impinduka zakozwe muri serivisi zitangwa binyuze mu bwishingizi bw’indwara bwa Mutuelle de Santé, zirimo gushyira mu bwishingizi serivisi zijyanye no kubona inyunganirangingo n’insimburangingo.

Ati: “Guhera ku wa 1 Nyakanga 2026, serivisi zijyanye no kubona ibyo bikoresho zashyizwe mu zo ubwishingizi bw’indwara bwita ku baturage, kugira ngo abafite ubumuga babashe kubibona bitabagoye.”

Dr. Mupenzi yavuze ko hari abafite ubumuga batabonaga serivisi zimwe na zimwe z’ubuvuzi bitewe n’ubushobozi buke cyangwa uburemere bw’ibibazo bafite, ariko ko hari ingamba zafashwe kugira ngo izo mbogamizi zigabanuke.

Yongeyeho ko umuntu utabashije kubona serivisi akeneye ashobora guhamagara inzego zibishinzwe kugira ngo afashwe kuyibona, asaba abafite ubwishingizi bw’indwara kubwitabaza igihe bakeneye serivisi.

Abagenerwabikorwa bagaragaje ko biteguye gukomeza ibikorwa by’iterambere batangiye, bashimangira ko ubumuga butababuza gukora, kwigira no kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’Igihugu.

Monty Done! Monty and his dog, Ned, have been a fixture on the show

TV horticulturalist Monty Don thanked viewers and his furry friend Ned the dog while presenting his final episode of Gardeners' World, after more than two decades on air.

The head gardener on the long-running BBC TV series signed off from Longmeadow garden, where the show has been based for 16 years, on Friday.

"From myself, Ned, and Longmeadow it's the final goodbye," he said on the programme, adding it had been "a privilege and pleasure" to share his garden experiences with so many people.

During the episode, Don, 71, confirmed he would remain part of the presenting line-up for next year's Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) Chelsea Flower Show.

Monty Don started on Gardeners' World in 2003, replacing Alan Titchmarsh

He added he will feature in two winter specials, expected to air between now and Christmas.

One celebratory episode will see him reflect on his years presenting the series and the changes he has seen at Longmeadow , external , which is also the garden of his private home, which he and his wife Sarah bought in 1991.

Don replaced Alan Titchmarsh on the show in 2003, at his predecessor's request.

"I first began presenting Gardeners' World 23 years ago at Berryfields, and we came here to Longmeadow 16 years ago - in that time, things have changed," he recalled, on Friday's farewell.

"The garden has grown, Nigel has been and gone, and Nellie and Patty [his previous dogs], but there has been one constant factor, and that has been the incredible privilege and pleasure of sharing my garden and my gardening life with you here, as well as working with so many superb people.

"So, thank you. Thank you for coming on that journey with me and good luck with your own gardens in the future. So, for the last time... goodbye."

Details of the next series of Gardeners' World will be announced at a later date, the BBC noted in a statement ahead of Don's farewell. His successor has not yet been named.

Bookmakers and viewers have pointed to regular co-presenters like Frances Tophill and Adam Frost as top contenders, though Tophill has played down expectations of stepping directly into his shoes.

Prior to fronting Gardeners' World, Don hosted other shows including Tomorrow's World, Holiday and - a preview of coming attractions - a gardening segment on This Morning.

He took a three-year break from the programme after suffering a minor stroke in 2008.

In September this year, Don announced that the current series would be his last. In a statement, he said working on the show had been a "deeply rewarding experience", but added that "now is the right time for a change".

The BBC said at the time that Don had "inspired and guided millions of viewers with his warmth, wisdom and passion for gardening" since joining the programme in 2003.

Don was made an OBE by Queen Elizabeth, in 2018, for services to horticulture, broadcasting and charity. And he also received the RHS Victoria Medal of Honour - highest honour in horticulture.

His final episode of Gardeners' World is available to stream now on BBC iPlayer.

Ibi bihembo byatanzwe kuri uyu wa 5 Ugushyingo 2026, mu gikorwa cyo gusoza icyumweru cyiswe Rwanda–Israel Creative Industries & Technology Week, cyabereye i Kigali, cyahuje inzego za Leta, abashoramari, impuguke n'abashoramari bakiri bato bafite ibigo by'ikoranabuhanga bikorera mu nganda ndangamuco.

DAJAH Music Group, ikigo gifasha abanditsi b'indirimbo, abahanzi, abahimbyi, abatunganya umuziki, ibigo by'umuziki n'abafite uburenganzira ku bihangano kurinda, gucunga no kubyaza umusaruro uburenganzira ku muziki wabo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ni cyo cyegukanye igihembo nyamukuru cy'amadolari ya Amerika 5,000.

Hervé Muvunyi, umwe mu bashinze DAJAH Music Group, yavuze ko iki gihembo ari intambwe ikomeye mu rugendo rw'ikigo, kuko kigiye kugifasha kongera ubushobozi bwo gutanga serivisi no kugeza igisubizo cyacyo ku bantu benshi.

Yagize ati: “Iki gihembo ni imbaraga nshya kuri twe. Kizatuma dukomeza kunoza uburyo dufasha abanditsi b'indirimbo, abahanzi n'abandi bafite uburenganzira ku muziki kurinda ibihangano byabo no kubibyaza umusaruro. Intego yacu ni uko umuhanzi atagomba gukora igihangano gusa, ahubwo agomba no kubona inyungu zituruka ku burenganzira agifiteho.”

Ikindi kigo cyegukanye igihembo ni SINC EVENT, cyahawe amadolari ya Amerika 3,000. Ni urubuga rw'ikoranabuhanga rwashyiriweho gufasha abantu kumenya ibirori n'ibikorwa bitandukanye, kugura amatike no gufasha ababitegura kubicunga.

Bazilia Maeva Rusamaza, umwe mu bashinze SINC EVENT, yavuze ko gutsinda iri rushanwa ari ibyishimo n'ikimenyetso cy'uko igitekerezo batangiye gifite ubushobozi bwo gukemura ibibazo biri mu rwego rw'ibikorwa n'imyidagaduro.

Ati: “Kwegukana iki gihembo ni ibintu bishimishije cyane kuri twe, kuko bitwereka ko ibyo twatangiye bifite agaciro kandi bishobora gutera imbere. Aya mafaranga azadufasha kunoza urubuga rwacu, kongera ubushobozi bw'ikoranabuhanga no kugera ku bantu benshi, haba abategura ibirori n'abifuza kubyitabira.”

Ambasaderi wa Israel mu Rwanda, Einat Weiss, yavuze ko icyumweru cy'udushya ari kimwe mu bikorwa igihugu cye cyateguye mu rwego rwo gushyigikira icyerekezo cy'u Rwanda cyo kuba igihugu kiyoboye ikoranabuhanga n'udushya muri Afurika no ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Yasobanuye ko intego ari ugufasha ba rwiyemezamirimo b'Abanyarwanda kumenya uko bahindura ibitekerezo n'ibikorwa byabo isoko y'amafaranga, binyuze mu kungurana ubumenyi n'impuguke zifite ubunararibonye mu guteza imbere ibigo by'ikoranabuhanga.

Ati: “Twifuza gufasha urubyiruko n'ibigo bito kumenya uko byabyaza umusaruro ibyo bikora. U Rwanda rufite urubyiruko rufite impano n'ibitekerezo byinshi. Icyo dushaka ni ukubafasha kubona ubumenyi, amahirwe n'uburyo bwo guhindura ibyo bitekerezo ubucuruzi bushobora kwaguka bukagera no ku masoko mpuzamahanga.”

Ambasaderi Weiss yavuze ko iki ari icyiciro cya kabiri cy'icyumweru cy'udushya, aho umwaka wabanje hibanzwe ku bigo bikiri mu ntangiriro, mu gihe kuri iyi nshuro hitabajwe ibigo byari bisanzwe bifite ibikorwa n'ibimenyetso byerekana ko ibisubizo byabyo bishobora gukora. Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y'Urubyiruko n'Ubuhanzi (MoYA), Parfait Ishungure, yavuze ko ikibazo cy'ingenzi uru rwego rugomba gukemura ari ukureba uko impano z'Abanyarwanda zahinduka isoko rirambye y'amafaranga ku bazihanga no ku bigo bibafasha kuzigeza ku isoko.

Yavuze ko mu minsi ine y'icyumweru cy'udushya, ibigo byitabiriye byahawe amahugurwa agamije kunoza imikorere yabyo mu bucuruzi, gusobanukirwa inshingano zijyanye n'uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge no gutegura uburyo byagura ibikorwa byabyo.

Ati: “Icyo twifuza ni uko impano z'abakora mu rwego rw'ubuhanzi zihinduka isoko irambye y'amafaranga ku bazihanga no ku bigo bizifasha kuzigeza ku isoko. Ni yo mpamvu tugomba kubaka ibigo bifite ubushobozi bwo guhangana, kubahiriza amahame mpuzamahanga no gucunga neza uburenganzira ku bihangano.”

Ibihembo byatanzwe muri iri rushanwa biri mu rwego rwo gushyigikira ibigo bifite ibisubizo bishobora kwaguka, bigafasha guhindura ubuhanzi n'ibindi bikorwa ndangamuco isoko y'amahirwe y'akazi n'ubukungu ku rubyiruko rw'u Rwanda. Hakaba hahembwe Company z’urubyiruko 3, zose hamwe zikaba zahembwe angana na 10,000 by’amadorali ya Amerika.

President Évariste Ndayishimiye of Burundi has donated 2,000 avocado seedlings to the Republic of Congo as part of an early launch of the United Nations Decade on Afforestation and Reforestation 2027–2036.

Republic of Congo’s President Denis Sassou Nguesso has reaffirmed his country’s commitment to protecting the environment through tree planting.

The UN Decade on Afforestation and Reforestation 2027–2036 ceremony took place on November 6, 2026, in the Congo capital Brazzaville.

Several African leaders and representatives of international organizations participated in the ceremony.

In total, some 200,000 tree seedlings were planted at a site prepared for the occasion, marking the start of this decade dedicated to afforestation and reforestation.

President Ngueso noted that Congo has celebrated a tree-planting day for fourty years.

“The time has come for nations to translate their environmental commitments into concrete action, particularly by planting new trees and replacing those that have been cut down,” Ngueso Said.

Meanwhile, President of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, Khalilur Rahman, called on all nations to step up their efforts in tree planting and reforestation.

He emphasized that trees help absorb the gases responsible for global warming and mitigate the harmful effects of climate change on people and the environment.

Amashirahamwe atandukanye aharanira agateka ka zina muntu yaneguye igihano co gupfungwa imyaka ine umukuru w'umugambwe CHADEMA, Tundu Lissu, yaciriwe na Sentare nkuru yo muri Tanzania ku wa gatanu, ku caha co guteza imigumuko.

Ku bwa Amnesty International, ico gihano ni ingaruka z'urubanza rivuga ko, kuva mu ntango, rwabaye ata muco n'ubutungane birimwo. Umuyobozi w'iryo shirahamwe mu karere ka Afrika y'ubuseruko n'iy'ubumanuko, Tigere Chagutah, yavuze ko Lissu atari akwiye gufatwa, kurengutswa canke kwagirwa n'ivyaha.

Nk'uko Amnesty ibivuga, Lissu yamaze imisi 577 apfunzwe vy'agateganyo azira ko yakoze ivyo arekuriwe n'amategeko. Ishimangira ko uwo munyapolitike yankiwe no kuvugana n'abamuburanira mw'ibanga, ivyatumye ahitamwo kwiburanira.

Iryo shirahamwe rivuga kandi ko ibiganiro vy'ikibiriraho ku kungene urubanza rwariko ruragenda vyaciye bihagarikwa, mu gihe bamwe mu bari baje kurukurikirana bavuye mu mahanga batawe muri yompi, mu nyuma bakirukanwa ku butaka bwa Tanzaniya. Ryemeza ko Tundu Lissu yapfunzwe mu buryo butabereye. Risaba Tanzaniya gufuta ico gihano, ikamurekura akidegemvya ata kirinze gusabwa, ikongera ikubahiriza uburenganzira bwo guserura ivyiyumviro no gukoranira hamwe mu mahoro.

Ku ruhande rwaryo, ishirahamwe Human Rights Watch (HRW) ryavuze ko ico gihano ari ikimenyetso c'ivyo ryise ukubandanya kw'agacinyizo gakorerwa abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi muri Tanzaniya. Ku bw'iryo shirahamwe, urubanza rwa Lissu rwatumye haduka amakenga ku bijanye n'agateka ka zina muntu kubera ko rwagiye rurateba kenshi, hamwe n'uko hari ibirego bivuga ko yankiwe kuvugana n'abamuburanira bari ukwa bonyene.

HRW yasavye abategetsi ba Tanzaniya kureka gukoresha ubutungane mu guhana abatavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi, ahubwo bakubahiriza uburenganzira bwa politike n'ubwo guserura ivyiyumviro.

Ishirahamwe Pan-African Solidarity Network (PASNet) na ryo ryasavye ko Lissu arekurwa ubwo nyene ata gisabwe. Rivuga ko ico gihano co gupfungwa imyaka ine gitumye hibazwa ibibazo ku kuntu urubanza rwiwe rwaburanishijwe no ku bwigenge bw'amasentare muri Tanzaniya.

PASNet ivuga ko Lissu yagiriwe n'icaha gitandukanye n'ico yari yagirijwe agifatwa, kandi ko atahawe akaryo gahagije ko kwiregura. Iryo shirahamwe ryagaragaje kandi amakenga ku bijanye n'amagara yiwe, kuronka ubuvuzi bwihariye hamwe n'ingaruka kuguma apfunzwe bishobora kugira ku muryango wiwe.

Risaba ONU, Ubumwe bwa Afrika (AU) hamwe na Komisiyo ya Afrika ijejwe agateka ka zina muntu gushinga umurwi wigenga wo ku rwego mpuzamakungu kugira utohoze ku birego vy'ihonyangwa ry'agateka ka zina muntu bivugwa ko ryabaye inyuma y'amatora rusangi yo mu 2025 muri Tanzaniya.

Ibirego vyo mu rubanza rwa Tundu Lissu vyari bishingiye ku majambo yagirizwa kuba yaravuze kw'igenekerezo rya 3 Ndamukiza (4) 2025, mu nama yahuje abakandida ba CHADEMA ku biro vy'umugambwe biri i Mikocheni, Dar es Salaam.

Ubushikirizamanza buvuga ko yari agamije guhimiriza abanyagihugu kubuza ko haba amatora rusangi yo muri Gitugutu (10) 2025, akagira n'intumbero yo gutera ubwoba reta. Ariko Tundu Lissu yarahakanye ivyo birego vyose.

Urwo rubanza rwatanguye kwumvirizwa ku mugaragaro muri Sentare nkuru kw'igenekerezo rya 8 Nyakanga (9) 2025, imbere y'abacamanza batatu.

Kw'igenekerezo rya 21 Myandagaro (8) 2026, sentare yaciye ifata ingingo y'uko Lissu yategerezwa kwisigura ku vyaha yagirizwa.

Banki ya Kigali (BK) yafunguye ku mugaragaro ishami rishya mu Karere ka Rubavu, mu rwego rwo kurushaho kwegera abakiriya no kuborohereza kubona serivisi z’imari.

Iki gikorwa cyabaye kuri uyu wa 6 Ugushyingo 2026 mu ruzinduko Umuyobozi Mukuru wa BK, Dr. Diane Karusisi, yagiriye muri aka karere, aho yanagiranye ibiganiro n’abakiriya b’iyi banki barimo Vision Jeunesse Nouvelle na RICO (Rubavu Investment Company).

Muri ibyo biganiro, Dr. Diane Karusisi yari agamije kumva ubunararibonye bw’aba bakiriya mu mikoranire yabo na BK, kumenya serivisi bishimira ndetse n’aho bifuza ko banki yakongera imbaraga kugira ngo irusheho kubafasha mu bikorwa byabo.

Perezida w’Urugaga rw’Abikorera (PSF) mu Karere ka Rubavu, Habarurema Antoine, yavuze ko guhura n’ubuyobozi bwa BK ari amahirwe yo kugeza ku rwego rw’ubuyobozi ibyifuzo by’abikorera, cyane cyane ibijyanye no guteza imbere ishoramari muri aka karere.

Yagize ati “Nk’abacuruzi bo mu Karere ka Rubavu, ni amahirwe kuba tubashije guhura n’Umuyobozi wa BK, kuko hari ibyifuzo byinshi abikorera batugaragariza, cyane cyane mu bijyanye n’ishoramari. Turifuza ko umujyi wacu wazamuka ukagera ku rwego rw’indi mijyi yose yo mu gihugu.

Dufite ibyifuzo bitandukanye, birimo koroshya uburyo bwo gutanga inguzanyo ku bacuruzi n’abikorera bakiri bato kugira ngo na bo babashe kwagura ibikorwa byabo.

Turifuza ubufatanye hagati y’abikorera na BK kugira ngo dufatanye kuzamurana. Iyo umucuruzi yungutse, banki na yo irunguka ariko kandi iyo banki yungutse n’umukiriya wayo aba akwiye kungukiramo. Ntitugomba kubona banki nk’ahantu tujya kubitsa cyangwa kubikuza amafaranga gusa, ahubwo dukwiye kuyibona nk’umufatanyabikorwa ukomeye udufasha kugera ku iterambere twifuza.”

Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rubavu w’agateganyo, Ruhamyambuga Olivier yavuze ko ishami rishya rya BK ryafunguwe mu Mujyi wa Gisenyi rizagira uruhare mu guteza imbere ishoramari muri aka karere, by’umwihariko korohereza abikorera kubona serivisi z’imari hafi yabo.

Yagize ati “Iyi banki ije gufasha mu kuzamura ishoramari mu Karere ka Rubavu, ifasha abantu bose bakora ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’abikorera muri rusange kubona serivisi za banki hafi yabo.

Iyo ibigo nk’ibi bigeze mu karere kacu, bifasha abikorera gukomeza kwagura ibikorwa byabo, bakabona inguzanyo mu buryo buboroheye, ibyo bakora bikarushaho gutera imbere natwe umujyi wacu tukabona iterambere, kuko ahanini iterambere turikesha abikorera ku giti cyabo.”

Yakomeje asaba abaturage bo mu Karere ka Rubavu kwitabira gukorana n’ibigo by’imari, bakitabira gahunda zo kugurizanya no gufata inguzanyo mu buryo bubafasha kwagura ibikorwa byabo, aho kumva ko serivisi z’imari zigenewe gusa abakora biro.

Ku ruhande rwa BK Umuyobozi Mukuru wayo, Dr. Diane Karusisi, yavuze ko kwegera abakiriya no kumva ibyifuzo byabo biri mu muco w’iyi banki, asobanura ko kwimura ishami ryayo i Rubavu rikajyanwa hafi y’isoko rya RICO biri muri iyo gahunda.

Duhora tugira ingendo zo kwegera abakiriya no kuganira na bo, twasuye ibikorwa bitandukanye by’ishoramari biteza imbere aka karere, kugira ngo tuganire n’abashoramari, dufatanye na bo kugira ngo ibikorwa byabo bigende neza, bakomeze guteza imbere aka karere.

Uyu munsi kandi twaje gufungura ishami ryacu rishya rya Rubavu. Twaryimuye turizana mu isoko rya RICO, kuko na byo biri muri gahunda yo kwegera abikorera. Mu isoko harimo abakiriya benshi bacu, kandi iyo tubegereye babona serivisi bitabagoye.

Icyo twifuza ni uko abakiriya bacu bakomeza gutera imbere, natwe tukabigiramo uruhare binyuze mu bufatanye.”

Gufungura ishami rishya rya BK mu Mujyi wa Gisenyi ni imwe mu ntambwe iyi banki iteye mu rwego rwo kwagura aho itangira serivisi, cyane cyane iyegereza abikorera n’abandi bakiriya bakorera mu isoko rya RICO.

Rubavu ni umwe mu mijyi ifite ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’ishoramari bikomeye mu Burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. Kwegera abikorera bahakorera bikaba ari uburyo bwo kumva ibibazo bahura na byo no kubafasha kubona serivisi z’imari zijyanye n’ibikenewe mu bikorwa byabo.

Iyi hoteli izaba igizwe n’icyumba cy’inama kizajya cyakira abantu barenga 1,000, resitora enye, ahantu abantu bazajya bicara hejuru bareba ibirunga n’Ikiyaga cya Kivu, ndetse n’ibyumba byo kuraramo.

Bizimungu yagize ati “Ni hoteli twifuza ko yaba ifite inyenyeri enye. Icyo twifuza kuri BK ni uko yadufasha kuyirangiza, kuko ubu inyubako tuyigeze kure. Ndetse no kuyubaka twari twaratangiye dufatanyije na yo, kandi kugeza ubu hari amafaranga tuyibereyemo. Ariko aho imirimo igeze, hakenewe imbaraga nyinshi kugira ngo irangire mu gihe gito. Icyo ni cyo twaje kubereka, kugira ngo tubereke ibyo dukeneye kugira ngo hoteli irangire itangire gukora.”

Bizimungu yavuze ko iyi hoteli izagira uruhare mu guhanga imirimo, kuko izaha akazi abantu bari hagati ya 300 na 400.

Yavuze kandi ko kugira ngo imirimo yose irangire, hoteli itangire gukora, izaba itwaye amafaranga arenga gato miliyari 10 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, cyangwa akagabanukaho gato.

Bamwe mu baturage ba Amerika batiyumvishaga ko byashoboka kubona abanyapolitiki baturuka mu mashyaka atandukanye bagirana ubucuti bumeze butyo, byarabatunguye.

George W.Bush yemeza ko ubwo bucuti bwe na Michelle Obama bwavutse bitewe n’uko mu birori cyangwa izindi gahunda za Leta babaga bicaranye cyangwa bahagararanye, bitewe n’uko bombi bari mu bahoze ari abayobozi bakuru b’igihugu n’abagore babo. Aha rero, muri Protocole ya Amerika, aba bombi iteka aho bahuriye mu birori byateguwe na Leta, yewe no mu kiriyo, bisanga bicaranye.

Ibyo ngo byabaye nko mu muhango wo gutangiza inzu ndangamurage y’amateka y’Abanyamerika b’Abirabura mu mwaka wa 2016, mu muhango wo gushyingura Nancy Reagan,wari Madame wa Ronald Reagan nawe wigeze kuyobora Amerika, ndetse no mu muhango wo gushyingura Senateri John McCain mu mwaka wa 2018. Buhoro buhoro, bagiranye ubucuti burangwa no kwisanzura no gusabana, batitaye cyane ku mategeko akomeye agenga imihango izo gahunda za Leta babaga barimo.

Mu muhango wo gushyingura John McCain mu mwaka wa 2018, George W. Bush yahaye Michelle Obama bombo ya Altoid igira impumuro y’ibyatsi byitwa ‘menthe’. Ifoto y’ako kanya amuhereza bombo, yakwirakwijwe cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, maze abantu benshi bayifata nk’ikimenyetso cy’uko abantu bafite ibitekerezo bya politiki bitandukanye,bashobora kubana neza no kugirana ubucuti bigakunda.

Uko Bush yabisobanuye mu gihe yabazwaga kuri iyo foto, cyane cyane mu kiganiro yagiranye n’umukobwa we Jenna Bush kuri televiziyo ya TODAY, yavuze ko muri izo gahunda yabaga yagiyemo, yumvaga atuje cyane, kuko yakundaga gutera urwenya na Michelle Obama, kandi ko icyo gihe atari azi neza icyo ijambo «trending» risobanura(ni ukuvuga ikintu kirimo kuvugwa cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga).

George W. Bush yasobanuye ko Michelle Obama yakundaga uburyo bwe bwo gusetsa kandi ko «bahise bakundana mu buryo bw’ubucuti». Yavuze ko Abanyamerika bari bakeneye kubona umuntu wo mu Ishyaka ry’Abarepubulike ufite ibitekerezo bitagendera ku murongo ukakaye ndetse n’umuntu wo mu Ishyaka ry’Abademokarate ufite ibitekerezo by’iterambere, bashobora kuganira no gusabana nk’abantu basanzwe

George W. Bush yashimangiye ko ubucuti bwe na Michelle Obama bwakomeye bitewe n’uko Michelle yakundaga uburyo bwe bwo gusetsa no gufata ibintu mu buryo bworoheje.

Yagize ati “Igihugu gifite inyota yo kubona umuntu wo mu Ishyaka ry’Abarepubulike ufite ibitekerezo bijyanye n’ishyaka rye, n’umuntu w’Umunyamerika w’Umunyafurika wo mu Ishyaka ry’Abademokarate ufite ibitekerezo bijyanye n’ishyaka rye, bishimye ndetse bagashobora kuganira no gusabana, atari nk’abanyapolitiki, ahubwo nk’abaturage basanzwe”.

Mu bihe bitandukanye, abo bombi bagiye bagaragaza ko, nubwo batavuga rumwe ku ngingo nyinshi za politiki bitewe n’uko umwe ari Umurepubulike undi akaba Umudemokarate,ariko basangiye indangagaciro zimwe na zimwe, zirimo urukundo, kubahana no kubana nk’abantu basanzwe.

Uko George W.Bush avuga ubucuti bwe na Michelle Obama, ni kimwe n’uko nawe Michelle ubwe abyivugira. Kuko nawe yagiye amuvuga mu buryo bwuje urugwiro, amwita ‘umuntu bafatanya mu bikorwa byo kwishimisha’(partner in crime) ndetse n’inshuti ye, cyane cyane mu birori bya Leta no mu yindi mihango rusange aho abahoze ari ba Perezida n’abagore babo bicara hamwe hakurikijwe umuco n’amategeko agenga iyo mihango.

Mu gihe cyose yabazwaga icyo atekereza ku bantu banenze ubucuti bwabo, Michelle Obama yagiye asobanura ko abantu bashobora kutemeranya kuri politiki ariko bagakomeza gusangira indangagaciro z’ubumuntu.

Mu biganiro bitandukanye, harimo n’ibyo yagiranye n’itangazamakuru mu rugendo rwo kumenyekanisha igitabo cye yise ‘Becoming’ cyasohotse mu mwaka wa 2018, ndetse no mu biganiro byakurikiyeho, yagiye avuga ati,”Ntitwemeranya kuri politiki n’amategeko yayo, ariko ntitunyuranya ku bijyanye n’ubumuntu. Ntabwo tunyuranya ku rukundo no kugira impuhwe”.

Yemeza ko ubucuti burenze amashyaka ya politiki. Yavuze ko uburyo bagaragarizanyamo ubucuti mu ruhame, nko guhana bombo z’inkorora cyangwa izindi bombo nto mu birori bitandukanye, ibintu byakoze ku mitima ya benshi, ari ikigaragaza ko abantu bashobora kubahana, kubana neza no kugirana ubucuti nubwo baba bakomoka mu mashyaka ya politiki atandukanye.

Michelle Obama yasobanuye ko akenshi bicara hamwe bitewe n'umuco n'amategeko agenga ibirori n’indi mihango ya Leta. Yemeza ko akunda uburyo George W. Bush asetsa, ndetse n'uburyo ashobora gutuma abantu bisanzura no mu bihe biba bikomeye kandi bisaba ituze.

Muri macyeya, Michelle Obama agaragaza ko ubucuti hagati ye na George W. Bush butagomba kureberwa mu ndorerwamo ya politiki gusa, ahubwo ko bushingiye ku kubahana, gusangira ubumuntu, urukundo n'ubushobozi bwo gusabana n'abantu bafite ibitekerezo bitandukanye.

George W.Bush we yigeze kuvuga ko yakundaga gusetsa Michelle Obama, kuko yumvaga ko mu buzima bwa Barack na Michelle Obama, babaga bakikijwe n’abantu bakomeye kandi bakunze gufata ibintu mu buryo bukomeye cyane.

Izo bombo za Altoids zamamaye kubera ko George W. Bush yajyaga aziha Michelle Obama, ngo ntiyigeze areka kuzimuha mu bihe bitandukanye, ndetse, ubwo hafungurwaga ku mugaragaro Ikigo cya Perezida Barack Obama i Chicago, muri Kamena 2026, George W.Bush yamuhaye agakarito kose k’izo bombo.

Reta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika na Repuburika ya Demokarasi ya Kongo (RDC) zivuga ko zigiye kwihutisha no gukomeza imigenderanire mu bijanye n'umutekano hamwe no gufashanya mu vy'ubutunzi, cane cane mu gisata co gucukura amabuye y'agaciro.

Biri mw'itangazo Amerika yasohoye, inyuma y'inama abaserukira ibihugu vyompi bahuriyemwo ku wa gatanu, i Paris, mu Bufaransa, mu ntumbero yo gusuzumira hamwe aho ishirwa mu ngiro ry'amasezerano yo gufashanya asanzwe hagati y'ivyo bihugu rigeze.

Mu bindi bisata Amerika ivuga ko itegekanya gushiramwo imitahe, harimwo igisata c'amasoko ntanganguvu n'ico kwunguruza abantu n'ibintu.

Aya masezerano yashizweko umukono hagati ya Amerika na RDC mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2025, mu co bamwe babona ko Perezida Félix Tshisekedi yarondera ko Amerika igira uruhara rufadika mu gufasha gutorera inyishu ikibazo c'umutekano muke, usa n'uwabaye akananirabahinga, kirangwa mu buseruko bw'igihugu ciwe.

Urunani AFC-M23, ruherutse guhinduka FRN, rwarigaruriye uturere dutandukanye muri Kivu ya Ruguru na Kivu y'Epfo, igisirikare ca RDC kikaba kitarashobora kurudukuramwo. Ubutegetsi bw'i Kinshasa n'abahinga ba ONU bagiriza Urwanda ko ari rwo rufasha abo barwanyi, ariko rwo rurabihakana. Ruvuga gusa ko rwashizeho ingamba z'ubwirinzi.

Itangazo ryashizwe ahabona na Amerika ntiritomora nimba hari imitahe ico gihugu kimaze gushora muri RDC, ukwo yoba ingana, canke ko hari iyo kigiye gushira mu migambi itandukanye vuba.

Ntirinavuga uburere ibikorwa vyo gucukura amabuye y'agaciro bizorangurirwamwo.

Ikizwi gusa ni uko ayo masezerano, yasinywe muri 2025, yemerera kompanyi zo muri Amerika kuzana imitahe mu gisata co gucukura amabuye y'agaciro nkenerwa cane kw'isi harimwo cobalt, cuivre, lithium, germanium, n'ayandi.

Nk'uko bigaragara muri iryo tangazo, impande zompi zishimangira ko amahoro n'umutekano ari vyo bizotuma ayo masezerano ashobora gushika ku co yashiriweho, na co kikaba ari iterambere rirama rya RDC n'iry'abenegihugu bayo.

Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC) yakangishije ko ishobora kuva mu Muryango w’Ibihugu bikoresha Igifaransa (Francophonie/OIF), mu gihe Umunyarwandakazi Louise Mushikiwabo yakongera gutorerwa kuyobora uyu muryango muri manda ya gatatu.

Amakuru yatangajwe n’ikinyamakuru Jeune Afrique ku wa 6 Ugushyingo 2026, avuga ko ubuyobozi bwa RDC buri gutekereza kuva muri uyu muryango mu gihe Louise Mushikiwabo yaba yongeye gutorerwa kuwuyobora. Iki kinyamakuru kandi cyatangaje ko u Bufaransa bwatangiye ibiganiro na Kinshasa, bigamije kuyumvisha ko idakwiriye gufata icyo cyemezo.

Kugeza ubu nta tangazo cyangwa umuyobozi mu butegetsi bwa Congo wari wavuga mu ruhame kuri ayo makuru.

Mushikiwabo uyobora OIF kuva muri Mutarama 2019, ashaka kongera kuyobora uyu muryango muri manda ya gatatu izamara imyaka ine.

U Rwanda rwamaze gutangaza ko rushyigikiye kandidatire ye, rugaragaza ko yakoze amavugurura mu mikorere y’uyu muryango kandi akawufasha kurushaho kugera ku nshingano zawo.

Mu mezi ashize, u Rwanda rwakomeje ibikorwa byo gushakira Mushikiwabo amajwi mu bihugu bigize OIF, mu rwego rwo kumufasha kongera kugirirwa icyizere cyo kuwuyobora.

Amatora y’Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa OIF ateganyijwe ku wa 16 Ugushyingo 2026, mu nama ya 20 y’uyu muryango izabera i Phnom Penh muri Cambodia, kuva ku wa 15 kugeza ku wa 16 Ugushyingo, 2026.

Abakandida bane bahatanira uyu mwanya ni Umunyarwanda Louise Mushikiwabo ushaka manda ya gatatu; Umunye-Congo Juliana Amato Lumumba, Coumba Bâ wa Mauritania na Dacian Cioloș wahoze ari Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Romania.

Abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinoma bigize uyu muryango ni bo bazahitamo uzawuyobora muri manda y’imyaka ine ya 2027-2030.

RDC ishyigikiye kandidatire ya Juliana Amato Lumumba, umukobwa wa Patrice Emery Lumumba wabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe wa mbere wa Congo. Kinshasa yatangaje kandidatire ye mu ntangiriro za 2026, inakora ibikorwa bitandukanye byo gushaka ibihugu biyishyigikira.

Bamwe mu banyapolitiki n’abakurikiranira hafi ibya Francophonie babona ko Kinshasa ‘ishobora kuba ishaka kwimurira cyangwa yimuriye muri uyu muryango ibibazo by’umubano ifitanye n’u Rwanda’, ikabikoresha mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza umukandida wayo no kurwanya kongera gutorwa kwa Mushikiwabo.

RDC ni kimwe mu bihugu bifite umubare munini w’abavuga Igifaransa ku Isi. Ibarura ryakozwe n’inzego za Francophonie rigaragaza ko gifite abaturage miliyoni 67,8 bavuga urwo rurimi, kikaba kiri imbere y’u Bufaransa.

Jeune Afrique yatangaje ko u Bufaransa bumaze iminsi bugirana ibiganiro na RDC, bigamije kuyumvisha ko ibibazo ifitanye n’u Rwanda bitagakwiye kugira ingaruka ku mikorere ya OIF cyangwa ku matora y’umuyobozi wayo.

Mu kiganiro yagiranye na France 24 ku wa 25 Nzeri 2026, Mushikiwabo yavuze ko ibibazo by’umubano hagati y’u Rwanda na RDC bitagakwiye kugira uruhare mu guhitamo uzayobora OIF.

Yavuze ko kuba ari Umunyarwandakazi abyishimira, ariko ko inshingano afite muri uyu muryango ari ugukorera ibihugu byose biwugize.

Ati “Ndi Umunyarwandakazi kandi binteye ishema, nkunda igihugu cyanjye. Ariko muri OIF nkorera ibihugu byose.”

Mu gihe imyiteguro y’amatora ikomeje, RDC yatangiye no kugaragaza impungenge ku buryo Umunyamabanga Mukuru azatorwamo mu gihe ibihugu bigize OIF bitazaba byumvikanye ku mukandida umwe.

Jeune Afrique yatangaje ko kimwe mu bibazo RDC n’ibihugu biyishyigikiye byibanzeho ari uburyo bwo kubara amajwi no kumenya utsinze mu gihe ubwumvikane busesuye butabonetse.

Amategeko yemejwe mu nama yabereye i Djerba muri Tunisie mu 2022 ateganya ko Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa OIF atorwa ku bwumvikane bw’ibihugu bigize uyu muryango. Iyo ubwo bwumvikane butabonetse, hakoreshwa amatora, hagatsinda umukandida wabonye amajwi menshi kurusha abandi.

Mbere y’Inama Ihoraho ya Francophonie yabereye i Paris ku wa 13 Ukwakira 2026, abahagarariye Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Mauritanie na Romania bandikiye uyu muryango ibaruwa ihuriweho, basaba ko basobanurirwa neza uburyo ayo matora azakorwa kandi bitari byarigeze bigaragaza inzitizi kuri ayo mategeko igihe yemezwaga mu 2022.

Mu nama yabereye i Paris, uhagarariye RDC yagaragaje ko atumva uburyo umukandida ashobora gutorwa atabonye nibura kimwe cya kabiri cy’amajwi y’abatoye. Uhagarariye Romania na we yabajije uburyo byagenda mu gihe hari abatemera ibyavuye mu matora.

Alassane Ndiaye, ushinzwe inzego n’inama za OIF, yasobanuye ko hakurikijwe ayo mategeko, umukandida utsinda ari ubonye amajwi menshi kurusha abandi, bitavuze ko agomba kurenga kimwe cya kabiri cy’amajwi yose yatanzwe.

Ku wa 19 Ukwakira 2026, Ndiaye yatanze inyandiko isobanura birambuye ubu buryo, agaragaza ko butandukanye n’ubusaba umukandida kubona amajwi arenga kimwe cya kabiri cy’ay’abatoye.

Ibi bongeye kuzamura impaka mugihe amajwi yaba agabanyijwe hagati y’aba bakandida bane bahatamyae, ibishoboka ko umukandida umwe yarusha abandi amajwi ariko ntabashe kugera kuri kimwe cya kabiri cy’amajwi yose y’abatoye.

Akoresheje izina ry'umwanditsi rya Muhorakeye , Joyeuse Marie Claire yatangiriye umusanzu we mu kurwanya ikibazo cy’inda ziterwa abangavu, maze yandika ibitabo bigaragaza amayeri atandukanye akoreshwa n’abashuka abo bangavu, bikarangira babagushije mu mutego, bikarangira ubuzima bwabo buhungabanye mu buryo butandukanye.

Joyeuse yagize igitekerezo cyo kwandika igitabo kimwe ndetse yandika n’icya Kabiri, nyuma y’uko yari amaze kubona ko nta bitabo bihari bihagije byanditse mu Kinyarwanda, bituma yibaza icyo yakora, kuko ngo nubwo hari imvugo ko ‘Abanyarwanda badakunda gusoma’, we yabonaga ko n’ababikunda, abakunda gusoma inkuru ndende, ntabyo gusoma babona, bitewe n’uko ibitabo byinshi bihari byanditse mu ndimi z’amahanga. Ubwe yagiye mu nzu zigurishiriwamo ibitabo, ashakamo igitabo cy’Ikinyarwanda yasoma arakibura.

Muhorakeye yanditse igitabo cya agamije kugaragaza imitego itandukanye abana bagushwamo,nk’uburyo bwe bwo kurwanya icyo kibazo cy’abangavu bisanga batewe inda.Nyuma yo kubona ko abo bangavu n’ingmbi bavuga Ikinyarwanda, yumvise uburyo bwiza bwo kubaha ubutumwa ari ukubwandika mu Kinyarwanda, maze yandika igitabo cya mbere yise ‘Umushibuka’, umushibuka bukaba ari ubwoko bw’umutego.

Yagize ati”, Iyo abantu bari muri gahunda yo kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge, biba byiza cyane kujyana umuntu wabibayemo, akerekana ububi bwabyo, akerekana uko yabiguyemo n’uko yabikize, bifasha benshi. Nararebye mbona ko abangavu n’ingimbi bacu,kugira ngo tubashe kubafasha bamenye iyo mitego bagwamo,ntibyakunda ko tugera kuri buri wese tumubwira ukwe,mpita mvuga nti uwakwandika ibitabo, akabikwirakwiza bikagenda bibageraho hirya no hino. Ni uko nanditse izo nkuru. Nandikiye ingimbi n’abangavu”.

Mu gitabo ‘Umushibuka’ Muhorakeye avugamo inkuru yahimbye, ariko azishingiye ku bintu byabayeho, harimo ibyo yabonye n’ibyo yaganiriye n’abantu mu bihe bitandukanye, kuko mu kazi ke nk’umunyamakuru yagiye agira umwanya wo guhura n’abantu bari mu ngeri zinyuranye bakamuganiriza ku byababayeho, ingaruka byabagizeho n’ibindi.

Inkuru ya mbere mu gitabo ‘Umushibuka’ ivuga ku mukobwa witwa Kanakuze w’imyaka 15 wigaga mu mwaka wa 4 w’amashuri yisumbuye, watewe inda nyuma yo gushukwa n’inshuti ye yitwa Kankindi, wamubeshye ko hari umuntu iwabo bamutumyeho, akamusaba ko yamuherekeza bakajyana kureba uwo muntu, ariko mu by’ukuri ari ikinyoma, ahubwo amugemuye ku musore. Uwo Kankindi yaribese arigendera, asiga inshuti ye Kanakuze mu nzu y’uwo musore birangira amusambanyije ku ngufu, bimuviramo gutwara inda atari abyiteze.

Inkuru ya Kabiri ivuga ku mukobwa witwa Nirere w’imyaka 19, nawe watewe inda agifite imyaka 17. Akomoka mu muryango wifashije kuko ababyeyi be bombi ni abakozi ba Leta, yatwaye inda, kubera ibyo yarebaga bitandukanye kuri televiziyo n’ahandi, hanyuma agira amatsiko yo kumenya uko bimera iyo umukobwa aryamanye n’umuhungu, abikorana n’umusore biganaga, kuko bigaga bataha hanze. Yaje kumenya ko yatwaye inda, ariko ntacyo uwo muhungu yari kumufasha kuko bose bari abanyeshuri. Nirere yaje kubyara impanga, ariko aza kugira ibyago abo bana bombi barapfa.

Inkuru ya Gatatu ivuga ku mukobwa witwa Mukamasabo w’imyaka 14 wigaga mu mwaka wa gatatu w’amashuri yisumbuye, watewe inda n’umusore wari ufite imyaka 21, wari urangije kwiga Kaminuza, ariko agakunda kuza iwabo, kuko ababyeyi ba Mukamasabo bari baramufashije mu myigire ye, bakamwishyurira. Mukamasabo yamufataga nk’umwe mu bagize umuryango we, ngo akamwita ‘Tonton’, bigatuma amwisanzuraho cyane. Uwo musore nawe ngo agakunda kumuha impano zitandukanye, rimwe aza kumuha utwenda yari yamuguriye nk’impano, amusaba ko yatwigera akamwereka niba tumubereye, ariko abikora ababyeyi badahari, maze muri uko kwigera imyenda, ahita amusambanya ndetse amutera inda.

Inkuru ya Kane, yo ivuga ku mukobwa witwa Murekatete w’imyaka 22 wari umudozi, kuko atashoboye gukomeza amashuri asanzwe. We ngo yivugira ko yatewe inda n’umusore wari ufite Butiki hafi y’aho yadoderaga, kubera ko yamugiriye impuhwe, bikarangira aryamanye nawe nubwo atari yabigambiriye. Uwo musore ngo yasabye Murekatete kumusura, ahageze amubwira ko yumva ameze nabi ku buryo, aramutse ataretse ngo baryamane, ashobora no gupfa. Murekatete ngo yahise amugirira impuhwe, arabyemera. Gusa nyuma yo kumenya ko yamuteye inda, uwo musore ngo yahise amwirengagiza, ntiyemera kugira ikintu na kimwe yamufasha.

Inkuru ya Gatanu ivuga ku mukobwa witwa Keza w’imyaka 16, we watewe inda nyuma yo gushukwa n’umuntu bamenyaniye kuri Facebook, hashira igihe bagatangira kujya bavugana kuri WhatsApp,noneho akaza kumusaba kujya kumusura. Keza ngo yarabyemeye, abeshya ababyeyi ko agiye gusura umuntu wo mu muryango, ariko birangira agiye kwisurira uwo musore bamenyaniye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Uwo musore yamuzimaniye Fanta irimo imiti ibiyobyabwenge, umukobwa arasinzira, birangira amusambanyije. Aho akangukiye asanga yaraye aho, atangira gusakuza yibaza uko byagenze, nyuma ngo umusore atangira kumubwira nabi, amubaza niba yari yaje kumusura azi ko nyirarume cyangwa se hari icyo bapfana kindi…Byaje kurangira Keza amenye ko yatwaye inda y’uwo musore.

Izo nkuru zose uko ari eshanu, zikubiye mu gitabo kimwe ‘Umushibuka’,igice cya mbere, ariko kizagira ibindi bice bikurikiraho, bizavuga uko ubuzima bwagenze nyuma y’uko guterwa inda zitateguwe.

Muhorakeye yanditse igitabo kivuga no ku rundi ruhande, bitewe n’uko hari ubwo abantu bibagirwa ko hari n’abasore cyangwa abagabo bahura n’ingaruka zo gutera inda zitateguwe, ndetse bikabaviramo ibibazo by’igihe kirekire.

Igitabo cya Kabiri yanditse yakise ‘Umutego mutindi’, ubusanzwe,ngo uwo ni umugani w’Ikinyarwanda uvuga ko umutego mutindi ushibukana nyirawo. Aho rero umwanditsi yashatse kuvuga ko mu basore cyangwa mu bagabo, harimo abashobora gutera inda abangavu bibwira ko nta ngaruka bibafiteho, ariko byazatinda bakisanga zabagezeho.

Mu Gitabo ‘Umutego mutindi’ harimo ubuhamya bw’umusore uri mu kigero cy’imyaka 30, wicuza kuba yarateye inda umunyeshuri mugenzi we mu gihe bari bakiga mu wa gatatu w’amashuri yisumbuye, maze umuryango wabimenya bigatuma atoroka akava mu gace bari batuyemo akajya kuba ahandi mu rwego rwo guhunga.

Muri icyo gitabo kandi harimo inkuru y’umugabo w’imyaka 55, wagiye atera inda abangavu benshi, ku buryo abo we yamenye, ngo bagera ku 10. Muri abo bangavu ngo harimo abo yashukishaga lifuti kuri moto, abo yaguriraga impano zitandukanye. Uwo mugabo yaje gushaka umugore, babyarana abana 4, ariko umwana w’imfura wabo w’imfura ageze mu kigero cy’ubwangavu nawe arashukwa ndetse aterwa inda.

Ariko ikibazo gikomeye yagize, ni uko uwo mwana yari azi imyitwarire Se yagize yo kuba yarabyaye abana hirya no hino. Ibyo byatumaga atamwemerera kugira icyo amubaza ku myitwarire afite, kuko yahitaga amubwira ko nta rugero rwiza amufiteho nk’umubyeyi, birangira yisanze atagira ijambo mu bana be.

Muhorakeye avuga ko yifuza ko ibitabo bye byagera ku rubyiruko rwinshi cyane cyane mu mashuri, kubera ko ari ho urubyiruko rwinshi ruri, cyane ko ari rwo rurebwa n’ubutumwa bukubiye muri ibyo bitabo. Abantu bifuza kubigura, ubu babisanga ku nzu zigurisha ibitabo harimo Librairie Ikirezi muri Kigali na Librairie Caritas mu Karere ka Huye.
